deadline.value: The Fall application deadline is February 1, 2027; the Spring deadline is October 1.

gre_general.value: The program page lists official GRE scores among the application materials. The graduate school's doctoral list says no GRE is required, so this conflict is noted.
gre_general.quote: In addition to the general Graduate School application materials, you must also submit: | Official GRE scores

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: You must get in touch with a faculty member you want to work with before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Before you apply, you'll need to get in touch with a faculty member under whom you would like to work

funding.value: Most graduate assistantships are awarded competitively on academic merit; the program page gives no separate funding rule.
funding.quote: are awarded on a competitive basis, with academic merit being the primary consideration

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter from a bachelor's degree (72 hours beyond it) or with a master's degree (24 hours of coursework).
entry_route.quote: A minimum of 72 semester hours of credit beyond the bachelor's degree is required | If you are entering the program with a master's degree, you must complete at least 24 hours
